zoe: Quick ask for launch blog: we need a minimal, auditable benchmark pack for the post and a short methodology note for legal.

zoe: Minimal deliverables:
- Warmup run: linear 10->120rps over 6m (light poisson jitter), hold 120rps ~8m (~8k reqs). Provide p50/p95/p99 + time-series CSV.
- Coldstart sweep: 2k single-shot requests across fresh pods, heatmap + raw csv.
- Quant variants: fp16, q4_0, q5_1 (if q5_1 OOM, record fallback).
- Long-tail: 8k token prompts (30 samples) with cold and warm KV.
- Samples manifest: sample IDs, seed, md5 of payload.
- Artifacts: warmup_timeseries.csv, cold_heatmap.png, quant_summary.csv, long_tail.csv, samples_manifest.json, runbook.txt, checksums.txt.

matt: Which model & cohort? embargo?

zoe: Model: "redwood-x-7b-lm". Cohort: marketing_cohort_v6, seed=99. Embargo until launch week. Mark EXPERIMENTAL flags in manifest.

anya: We'll run on pool-2. Plan 3 jobs: job-warmup-7701, job-cold-7702, job-quant-7703. Will upload to s3://internal-bench/marketing/1795000000/ and attach md5s. ETA ~24h.

matt: Product needs a single PNG for the post (warmup_blog.png) and claims_audit.txt mapping p95 to plain English sentence.

anya: Example command we'll include (token redacted):

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-x-7b-lm","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":1024,"stream":false}'
```

anya: I'll post S3 paths + MD5s here when done and tag @zoe @matt. If any quant variant OOMs or shows >12% perf regression vs fp16 we'll call it out with fallback and impact note.

runtime-bot: job-warmup-7701 queued on pool-2 (est runtime ~80m). Logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/runs/7701. Notifying participants on completion.
